name: 56537 · Fergus Falls, MN
findings: ZIP 56537 (Fergus Falls) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56537 (Fergus Falls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56537 (Fergus Falls) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
